_note: Who may sell each brand (engine/trust.py). Keys are normalised brand names; aliases are other names the brand sells under, written the way engine.normalize.norm_brand writes them (lower case, no spaces or punctuation: 'cmfbynothing'). Demo brands (kelvo, voltnova, viewmax) are fictional. Real brands come ONLY from a list or statement the brand itself published, with the page (source_url) and the date it was read (retrieved) or published (as_of); nothing is added from memory, news posts or forums. A seller the brand named counts for the whole brand unless the entry has per-marketplace lists. Fields: domains (the brand's own sites: always authorised); sellers (flat list, any marketplace); marketplaces (per shop, keyed by its registrable domain: the sellers the brand named on that shop; when present this list is used for that shop); official_channels (where the brand says it sells online, by domain, when it names channels but not sellers); offline_partners (named stores, not online sellers); list_pending_url (a list the brand published that could not be read yet); notes (what the brand's own page says); list_kind (sellers | channels | own_store: the brand's own websites only, no marketplace list). A seller named here matches the marketplace's full name by its start (Clicktech Retail matches Clicktech Retail Private Ltd). seller_aliases ({listed name: [other names the same company trades under]}: SafeShelf's own additions, always labelled as such in answers); 'Display name / company' pairs on a brand's page are split into two names.
